name: Procedural songs
what: Whole songs from a seed with no sound files: a hook melody over 4-bar chord progressions, drums, bass, arpeggio, pad and lead synthesised with Web Audio; menu, game, tense and results arrangements in one key; an intensity value that layers instruments in and out, opens the filter and lifts the tempo; a beat-quantised crossfade to a tense minor version.
use_when: the game wants background music that never repeats and rises with tension or game phase, without audio files or paid generated tracks
good_for: Upbeat arcade, party and casual games with rounds: a new song each round, tension that builds, a sudden-death switch, a results jingle. Also a seeded title theme.
not_for: Calm, sad, orchestral or horror scores without rewriting its progressions and voices; games that need a specific composed track; anything that must sound like real instruments. Nobody has judged by ear how it sounds: listen before shipping.
